content:
Hello! 👋 I'm your AI Construction Consultant.

Tell me about your dream house:
• **City & area** — Where do you want to build?
• **Plot size** — How many marla/kanal?
• **Floors** — Single, double, triple storey?
• **Budget** — What's your range in PKR?
• **Type** — Grey structure or full finish?

I'll find the best companies and suppliers for you! 🏠
(آپ اردو میں بھی بات کر سکتے ہیں)
I want to build a 5 marla house in Lahore DHA, budget 80 lacs

Great! Lahore DHA mein 5 marla house plan kar rahe hain aur budget 80 lakh PKR hai. Ab thodi si extra detail chahiye taake main aapko sahi companies aur cost breakdown de sakun:

1. **Construction type** – Sirf grey structure chahte hain ya full finish (walls, flooring, paint, fixtures wagaira)?
2. **Floors** – Kitni manzilen (single storey, duplex, ya teen manzila)?

In dono sawalon ka jawab dene ke baad, main aapko Lahore ke top 3 match companies aur detailed cost estimate bhej dunga. 😊
